scope: Every ##INFO and ##FORMAT declaration in the dedicated structural-variant INFO and FORMAT definition sections of VCFv4.1, VCFv4.2, VCFv4.3 and VCFv4.4, with exact source line and declaration text. This inventory does not include general reserved INFO/FORMAT tables, and does not yet atomize all surrounding prose.

observed_deltas: VCFv4.1 and VCFv4.2 use Number=2 for CIPOS/CIEND and retain signed SVLEN with Number=.; these are not the 4.4 per-ALT paired-vector definitions.
VCFv4.1 and VCFv4.2 include SVTYPE=BND and breakend INFO fields in their SV encoding model.
VCFv4.3 continues the earlier SV field definitions and has no VCFv4.4 SVCLAIM, EVENTTYPE, or tandem-repeat field family.
VCFv4.4 changes SVLEN to Number=A and defines CIPOS/CIEND as successive ALT-specific offset pairs; MATEID/PARID/EVENT/EVENTTYPE become Number=A fields.
VCFv4.4 introduces SVCLAIM, tandem-repeat INFO fields (RN/RUS/RUL/RUC/RB/CIRB/CIRUC/RUB), and revised copy-number semantics.
VCFv4.4 SV FORMAT CN/CNQ/CNL/CNP declarations differ from 4.1-4.3 and support float copy number and genotype-indexed CNL/CNP.
limitations: A source declaration row is not necessarily a mandatory field occurrence in every record.
Description strings are not a substitute for the surrounding semantic clauses; full-context review remains required.
The VCFv4.4 change log is used only to discover candidate deltas; section definitions are the primary source.
The row inventory captures every field declaration in the dedicated SV INFO/FORMAT sections; row-specific normative clauses still require atomization and cross-version applicability mapping.

field_semantic_deltas.finding: END is described as the end position of the variant; for precise variants it is POS + length(REF) - 1, and for imprecise variants it is the corresponding best estimate.

SVLEN is Number=. Integer and describes the difference in length between REF and ALT; negative deletion values appear in the version examples. It is not yet the VCFv4.4 positive class-specific Number=A definition.

SVLEN is Number=A Integer, one value per ALT; required for symbolic SV alleles and defined as positive inserted/duplicated/inverted/deleted length or CNV segment length. Legacy negative values are interpreted by absolute value.
Both are Number=2 Integer confidence intervals for imprecise variants; they are not yet the VCFv4.4 per-ALT successive offset-pair arrays.

Both use Number=. Integer; when present they contain successive pairs per ALT. CIPOS offsets are relative to POS; CIEND offsets are relative to END inferred from SVLEN. CIEND missing defaults to CIPOS.
SVTYPE is an active Number=1 String structural-variant type key, with type values including BND in the earlier breakend model.
SVTYPE remains in the reserved declaration but is explicitly deprecated in the VCFv4.4 change log as redundant with ALT; do not treat its declaration as a requirement to emit it.
MATEID is Number=. and PARID/EVENT are Number=1 in the source declarations; they have record/event-level semantics rather than the VCFv4.4 per-ALT schema.
MATEID, PARID and EVENT become Number=A, and EVENTTYPE is introduced as Number=A; each ALT's relationships/classification are represented in ALT order.
CILEN is Number=2 Integer and describes the confidence interval around inserted material between breakends.
CILEN is Number=. Integer and describes the confidence interval for SVLEN, with successive pairs per ALT.

Earlier INFO CN is a scalar Integer copy number of the segment containing a breakend; FORMAT CN is an Integer copy-number genotype for imprecise events. CNADJ/DPADJ/CICNADJ are present in earlier INFO field sets.

INFO CN becomes Number=A Float copy number of CNV/breakpoint; FORMAT CN becomes Number=1 Float total copy number. CNL and CNP are Number=G Float genotype-indexed vectors, with CNP introduced in 4.3. The earlier CNADJ/DPADJ/CICNADJ keys are absent from 4.4 SV field declarations.
4.4 adds SVCLAIM and tandem-repeat fields RN/RUS/RUL/RUC/RB/CIRUC/CIRB/RUB; no corresponding field family exists in 4.1-4.3.
Earlier versions include BND in the symbolic SV type model and use SVTYPE=BND for single breakends in examples and prose.
The VCFv4.4 change log disallows BND ALT records and directs use of breakpoint notation; this is a version-specific change.
